body.name: Known-bound STAR scaling and randomized balanced subsample
body.construction: Draw \(U_j^{\mathrm{STAR}}=(Y_j(1),Y_j(2),Y_j(3))\) independently from \(Q^{\mathrm{STAR}}\) for \(j\in\mathcal J^{\mathrm{STAR}}\). Independently assign the units by complete randomization with cell counts \(n^{\mathrm{STAR}}=(161,37,36)\). Conditional on the assignment, draw each ordered \(S_k^{\mathrm{STAR}}\) uniformly without replacement with size \(m^{\mathrm{STAR}}=36\), using auxiliary randomness independent of all potential outcomes. Apply the known affine map \(s_{B^{\mathrm{STAR}}}(y)=y/B^{\mathrm{STAR}}\) and set \(X_{ki}^{\mathrm{STAR}}=(\beta_k^{\mathrm{STAR}}Y_{J_{ki}}(k)/b_Y,0,0,0,0)\in\mathbb B_5\), where \(b_Y=B^{\mathrm{STAR}}\max_{1\le\ell\le3}|\beta_\ell^{\mathrm{STAR}}|\).
